The tool runner received the full package, but the model-visible displayed output omitted its middle. The model declined a full answer. This is not full-package client acceptance.

limitations: Observation of one account and the named model surfaces on the recorded date; not universal compatibility.
Model-reported absence of host truncation is separate from raw package equality verified through MCP clients.
The eight small hospital records are authored concepts, not a body of authoritative hospital evidence.
No private ChatGPT conversation URL, account identifier or claimant information is retained.
